raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE Project Manager Senior Lead | Enterprise Program Delivery | FIS GLOBAL Jul 2025 – Jul 2026 · Chennai, India

Led Value Stream design and transformation for the Enterprise Prepaid Payments organization, aligning 110+ engineers across 8 Journey and 3 Kanban teams and coordinating Product Owners, Product Managers and System Architects across North America, Europe and Canada; established delivery governance, PI readiness and portfolio visibility to coordinate multi-team PI and sprint execution.
Managed enterprise prepaid and payment programs within FIS Banking and Payments Services, coordinating Product, Engineering, Architecture and delivery stakeholders across North America, Europe and Canada and driving governance across multi-geography payment initiatives.

Established structured programme governance covering delivery status, dependencies, risks, readiness criteria, stakeholder actions and executive reporting, providing consistent visibility across distributed teams and geographies.

Improved Agile maturity and delivery governance by standardizing Definition of Ready/Done, Value Stream KPIs and delivery metrics; strengthened PI Readiness, PI Planning, Value Stream/Solution Syncs, Executive Reviews and System Demonstrations, improving Comparative Agility Score from 3.0 to 4.5 and reducing PI Planning preparation effort by 30%.

Strengthened portfolio governance and executive visibility by establishing Power BI and Jira dashboards spanning Portfolio Health, Program Status, PI Readiness, Team Performance, Delivery Health, OKRs and KPI tracking, while partnering with Product Management to improve backlog quality, Epic definition, prioritization and roadmap readiness.
• Designed and implemented six AI-powered Microsoft Copilot agents integrated with Jira to automate epic/user- story creation, dependency analysis, risk identification and executive reporting; reduced Program Risks by 30%, Product Planning effort by 50% and Executive Reporting effort by 65%, while improving leadership confidence with
consistent, current delivery data.
•
Protected an at-risk PI objective by identifying a shared Architecture dependency during PI Planning, quantifying the effort, securing executive reprioritization, and resolving the dependency within the first two sprints; the governance improvements subsequently contributed to a 50% reduction in dependency-resolution time.
Directed planning, sync, execution and delivery across distributed Offshore-Onshore team structures, coordinating cadence and handoffs between the Chennai-based delivery organization and onshore stakeholders in North America, Europe and Canada.
Owned JIRA hygiene and sprint planning oversight across teams: enforced backlog readiness, decomposition of work into epics/stories with traceable acceptance criteria and coordinated sprint commitments to improve predictability and delivery cadence.
Project Manager Senior | Cross-Functional Delivery | FIS GLOBAL Nov 2019 – Jun 2025 · Chennai, India
Orchestrated two Agile Release Trains delivering enterprise payment modernization across FIS' global Prepaid Solutions organization, governing end-to-end PI execution across 15 Scrum Teams, 110+ Engineers, 8 Product Owners, 8 Product Managers, 6 System Architects and multiple Engineering Leaders.
Delivered enterprise prepaid card programs for banking and financial institution clients including Amex, US Bank, PSCU, Prepaid Technologies, Wells Fargo, Citibank and USAA, spanning Benefit, Gift, Companion, Healthcare, Teen and Loyalty card products. Led card migration planning covering client, program, cardholder and transaction-data mapping/migration, payment authorization and settlement, processor and back-office configuration, transaction alerting and client reporting, coordinating business, product, through controlled technology and implementation. release stakeholders


Built PI and sprint roadmaps and executive dashboards (Jira, Power BI) for PI readiness, delivery forecasting and portfolio governance; partnered with Product Management to improve Epic and user-story definition, prioritization and roadmap readiness to support multi-team delivery decisions.

Coached Scrum Masters, Product Owners and delivery teams in SAFe practices while driving continuous improvement through backlog readiness, disciplined capacity-based planning, dependency governance and mid-PI intervention, strengthening enterprise Agile maturity and release quality.

Improved PI predictability from 75% to 90% over approximately two to three PIs, increased Team Velocity by 25%, reduced Cycle Time by 30%, Lead Time by 25%, and Production/Escaped Defects by 30% through stronger Definition of Ready, historical-velocity-based capacity planning and mid-PI checkpoints.

Turned a planning failure—60% of committed scope delivered—into a sustainable governance improvement by identifying an unconfirmed external-vendor API dependency as the root cause, introducing mandatory dependency confirmation before PI commitment, and achieving 88% predictability in the following PI.
Managed internal and external vendor coordination for API dependencies on the Filtered Spend program, driving joint planning and issue resolution across FIS internal teams and third-party vendor partners to keep integration milestones on track.
Project Manager | Scrum Master | FIS GLOBAL Dec 2015 – Nov 2019 · Chennai, India

Facilitated Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Reviews and Retrospectives for enterprise payment projects; strengthened backlog quality and user-story readiness with Product Owners to increase sprint predictability and delivery transparency.

Coordinated cross-team dependencies and implementation planning across Product Management, Engineering and QA; developed dashboards covering Sprint Health, Velocity, Risks, Defects, Team Performance and Delivery Progress, increasing leadership visibility into delivery health.

Introducing AI-assisted reporting integrations across Jira, Rally, Planview and Clarity, reducing project reporting effort and consolidating leadership delivery metrics; contributed to architecture reviews, solution design and quality-assurance planning while championing Agile best practices and continuous improvement.

Led delivery of the AMEX platform conversion program using phased Waterfall and hybrid Waterfall-Agile execution, including migration planning, milestone-gate tracking, stakeholder coordination, change control, release readiness and controlled platform transition.
Defined launch and migration playbooks for project releases and card migration go-lives, coordinating UAT, performance, SLA and stakeholder readiness criteria and securing sign-offs before controlled production deployment. Built and maintained RACI matrices and transitional ownership models for payments and migration initiatives,
clarifying responsibilities across client, product, technology, operations and external processor/vendor teams during implementation and handoffs.
Maintained programme risk and issue registers, proactively identifying delivery, migration and operational risks, coordinating mitigation actions with stakeholders and driving resolution before risks impacted release or go-live commitments.
Managed stakeholder governance across banking/payment clients, product teams, architecture, engineering, operations and vendor teams spanning North America, Europe and Canada, coordinating cross-geography dependencies, decisions, readiness and delivery commitments.
Delivered multi-geography payment and card program initiatives across the USA, Canada and Europe, applying phased migration planning, readiness criteria, stakeholder governance and controlled cutover practices that can be scaled into a global country-wave migration framework.
Managed transitions of card programs between clients, processors and delivery teams, coordinating changes to ownership, processes, data, configuration and stakeholder responsibilities to support controlled migration and operational continuity.
Technical Lead | FIS GLOBAL Apr 2012 – Nov 2015 · Chennai, India

Led technical delivery, architecture collaboration, modernization and DevOps enablement across enterprise payment platforms; partnered with Product Management, QA, Architecture, Infrastructure and Operations on REST APIs, Microservices, OAuth, API Gateway, CI/CD, SQL Server, Azure DevOps and event-driven integrations; built CI/CD pipelines and mentored engineers.
Directed delivery of FIS' proprietary Filtered Spend item-level payment authorization platform across five Scrum Teams supporting Walmart and Nations Benefits; delivered the MVP ahead of schedule and earned the Win as One Team Award; modernized Config NOW into a web platform and eZCard from legacy ColdFusion to a responsive Angular customer portal, improving operational efficiency, client onboarding, customer experience and maintainability.
Delivered On-Demand Funding through real-time prepaid funding and REST-based architecture, enabling dynamic authorization and reducing unnecessary prepaid balances; modernized XNet by consolidating Email, SMS, XML notifications, scheduled reporting and self-service configuration into one platform, reducing operational complexity.

Replaced Excel-based Bulk Orders & Photo Card Management with an enterprise web application supporting ~50 new clients; implemented automated offline risk processing and dead-letter queue handling, reducing failed identity verification transactions by 30%.
IT Specialist | FIS GLOBAL Apr 2010 – Mar 2012 · Chennai, India
Developed and enhanced enterprise payment-processing applications supporting prepaid card solutions using C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, Web Services and REST-based integrations; contributed to payment authorization, settlement and customer-servicing applications.

Partnered with Architecture, QA, Infrastructure and Product teams to deliver enterprise releases while improving application performance, maintainability and production stability, progressing into broader technical leadership responsibilities.
Senior Software Engineer | FIS GLOBAL May 2008 – Mar 2010 · Chennai, India
Delivered enterprise applications supporting payment processing, client servicing, reporting and operational platforms using C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, SSRS and Web Services; built reusable components that improved development productivity and translated complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Contributed to system integration, performance tuning and production support across enterprise applications.
Software Engineer | eFUNDS INTERNATIONAL June 2006 – April 2008
Software Engineer | MAGNUM OPUS INFO SOLUTIONS Sep 2005 – Jun 2006
